nodes.name: thresholds.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying platform-specific decision thresholds returned by thresholdFor for tiktok, instagram, and youtube.

nodes.name: auto-calibrator.ts
nodes.summary: Analyzes recent predictions vs actuals to compute per-component calibration adjustments, then produces update objects and a human-readable report.

nodes.name: analyzeCalibration
nodes.summary: Compares predicted vs actual viral scores per component, computing mean error, std dev, and recommended adjustments above the calibration drift threshold.

nodes.name: applyCalibrationUpdates
nodes.summary: Applies CalibrationUpdate records to existing component configs, returning a new map of calibrated configs.

nodes.name: createCalibrationHistoryEntry
nodes.summary: Builds a CalibrationHistoryEntry from a CalibrationUpdate with timestamp and provenance metadata for audit logs.

nodes.name: calculateCalibrationConfidence
nodes.summary: Computes a 0-1 confidence score for a calibration update based on sample size and consistency of the recommended adjustment.

nodes.name: getCalibrationReport
nodes.summary: Formats a CalibrationAnalysis into a multi-line human-readable diagnostic report for ops dashboards.

nodes.name: binning.ts
nodes.summary: Builds equal-width probability bins and aggregates predictions with labels into bin-level statistics for reliability diagrams.

nodes.name: calibrated-prompts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines calibrated LLM prompt templates (GPT-4, Gemini, pattern, XGBoost features, system) tuned to align scores with empirical viral outcomes.

nodes.name: calibration.ts
nodes.summary: Trains and applies probability calibration models (isotonic regression + Platt scaling) over the last 30 days of predictions, persisting models per platform/niche/format.

nodes.name: ensureCalibrationTables
nodes.summary: Creates the SQL tables (prediction_outcomes, calibration_models) required for storing predictions and trained calibration knots if they don't already exist.

nodes.name: trainCalibrationModelsForLast30d
nodes.summary: Groups recent prediction outcomes by platform/niche/format and fits isotonic regression with Platt fallback, persisting trained knots and decision thresholds.

nodes.name: applyCalibration
nodes.summary: Looks up the active calibration model for a platform/niche/format and maps a raw probability through isotonic knots to a calibrated probability.

nodes.name: getDecisionThreshold
nodes.summary: Retrieves the niche-specific decision threshold from the active calibration model, falling back to a default target precision.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting score calibration, negative-signal detection, auto-calibration analysis, and calibrated LLM prompts from the calibration package.

nodes.name: isotonic.ts
nodes.summary: Implements isotonic regression via the pool-adjacent-violators algorithm, producing monotonic knot points from predicted/label pairs.

nodes.name: metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Provides calibration evaluation metrics: expected calibration error (ECE) and area under the ROC curve (AUC).

nodes.name: negative-signals.ts
nodes.summary: Detects negative and positive signals in video transcripts (e.g. weak hooks, jargon, urgency, hooks) and applies bonus/penalty adjustments to a base score.

nodes.name: detectNegativeSignals
nodes.summary: Scans a transcript for catalogued negative phrases and structural anti-patterns, returning matched NegativeSignal records with severity.

nodes.name: detectPositiveSignals
nodes.summary: Scans a transcript for catalogued positive phrases (strong hooks, urgency, concreteness) and returns matched PositiveSignal records with weights.

nodes.name: calculatePenalty
nodes.summary: Sums weighted penalties from a list of negative signals into a single deduction value.

nodes.name: calculateBonus
nodes.summary: Sums weighted bonuses from a list of positive signals into a single bonus value.

nodes.name: applySignals
nodes.summary: Composes negative and positive signal detection over a transcript, applying bonus and penalty to a base score with clamping and diagnostic output.

nodes.name: applyNegativeSignals
nodes.summary: Legacy wrapper around applySignals that only applies negative signal penalties for backward compatibility.

nodes.name: getSignalSummary
nodes.summary: Produces a short human-readable summary of detected positive and negative signals for use in UI explanations.

nodes.name: score-calibrator.ts
nodes.summary: Per-component score calibrator applying mean/scale corrections (Rule 4 from the calibration audit), weighted aggregation, and online learning of new calibration configs.

nodes.name: calibrateScore
nodes.summary: Applies a per-component calibration config (offset, scale, clamping) to a raw component score returning the corrected value.

nodes.name: calibrateAllScores
nodes.summary: Calibrates every component score in a map by looking up its config in DEFAULT_CALIBRATIONS.

nodes.name: calculateWeightedScore
nodes.summary: Computes the weighted average of calibrated component scores using a weights map, normalizing for missing components.

nodes.name: learnCalibration
nodes.summary: Fits a new CalibrationConfig for a component by computing mean error and scale ratio from a sample of historical predictions vs actuals.

nodes.name: calculateMeanError
nodes.summary: Computes mean signed error between calibrated predictions and actual outcomes for monitoring drift.

nodes.name: thresholds.ts
nodes.summary: Exports thresholdFor returning per-platform default decision thresholds (tiktok 0.7, instagram 0.6, youtube 0.5).

nodes.name: codebase-map.ts
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable code map of the Trendzo codebase from the codebase index, used to ground the Canvas AI in real project structure.

nodes.name: getCodebaseMap
nodes.summary: Returns a formatted markdown overview of routes, API endpoints, components, libraries, and SQL tables derived from the codebase index.

nodes.name: codebase-scanner.ts
nodes.summary: Scans the project tree to extract pages, API methods, components, exports, SQL tables, env vars, and dependencies, caching a structured CodebaseIndex.

nodes.name: getCodebaseIndex
nodes.summary: Memoized accessor that builds and caches the CodebaseIndex on first call for Canvas context retrieval.

nodes.name: walkDir
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a directory accumulating file paths while skipping node_modules, .next, .git, and other ignored directories.

nodes.name: parseExports
nodes.summary: Regex-extracts named and default exports from a TypeScript/JavaScript file's source content.

nodes.name: parseSqlTables
nodes.summary: Extracts CREATE TABLE statements from a SQL file, returning table names and column metadata for the codebase index.

nodes.name: buildCodebaseIndex
nodes.summary: Walks the project to construct the full CodebaseIndex: routes from app/, API endpoints, components, libs, SQL tables, env vars, and dependencies.

nodes.name: context-builder.ts
nodes.summary: Assembles knowledge-pack context strings (methodology, operations, objectives, frameworks, research, codebase map) for the Canvas AI system prompt, with per-pack truncation.

nodes.name: getKnowledgeContext
nodes.summary: Builds a structured context string from selected knowledge packs and the codebase map, truncated to the requested per-pack character budget.

nodes.name: file-reader.ts
nodes.summary: On-demand source file reader for the Canvas AI: reads single files, batches, or searches the codebase index for files matching keyword terms.

nodes.name: readSourceFile
nodes.summary: Reads a single source file by project-relative path, returning truncated content with diagnostic metadata for the AI context.

nodes.name: readSourceFiles
nodes.summary: Reads multiple source files capped by total character budget, returning the concatenated results for AI grounding.

nodes.name: getRelevantFiles
nodes.summary: Scores files in the codebase index against keyword search terms and returns the highest matching files within a total character budget.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the Canvas knowledge subsystem: context builder, codebase scanner/map, file reader, and pack loader.

nodes.name: pack-loader.ts
nodes.summary: Loads markdown knowledge packs (methodology, operations, objectives doc, frameworks, research) from the docs directory into in-memory cached strings.

nodes.name: readAllByPrefix
nodes.summary: Reads all markdown files in the knowledge-packs directory with a given filename prefix and concatenates them into one cached string.

nodes.name: ai-system-prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Canvas AI system prompt template and assembler that injects knowledge-pack context for a given Canvas template type.

nodes.name: getCanvasSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Returns the Canvas AI system prompt with knowledge context filled in for the given template type.

nodes.name: models.ts
nodes.summary: Catalog of Canvas AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) with provider labels, tier colors, defaults, and helpers to look up models by id or provider.

nodes.name: quick-actions.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the catalog of quick-action chips shown on dashboard cards plus a niche-aware helper to fetch the active set.

nodes.name: action-handler.ts
nodes.summary: Server-side dispatcher executing every Clay component write action (briefs, invites, nudges, agency events, scheduling, reporting) against Supabase with auth and audit logging.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 1091-line dispatcher with 25 internal action handlers; emits agent.proposal events per substrate-pivot Phase 2 v2.

nodes.name: handleComponentAction
nodes.summary: Central dispatcher that routes a Clay component action to the appropriate handler, performing auth, RPC gating, and emitting platform_events.

nodes.name: approveBrief
nodes.summary: Marks a content brief as approved in Supabase and emits an agent action event for audit.

nodes.name: rejectBrief
nodes.summary: Marks a content brief as rejected in Supabase and emits an agent action event for audit.

nodes.name: generateBriefFromTrend
nodes.summary: Generates a new content brief seeded from a detected trend event, inserts it into content_briefs, and emits an audit event.

nodes.name: generateRecoveryBrief
nodes.summary: Generates a recovery-themed brief for a creator whose recent performance has decayed.

nodes.name: approveTrainerExperiment
nodes.summary: Approves a trainer experiment row, transitioning its state and emitting an event for the active learning pipeline.

nodes.name: rejectTrainerExperiment
nodes.summary: Rejects a trainer experiment row and emits an event so it is excluded from training data.

nodes.name: selectVariant
nodes.summary: Marks a variant as the chosen output for a brief and updates downstream scheduling fields.

nodes.name: updateBriefStatus
nodes.summary: Updates a content brief's lifecycle status (acknowledged, published, etc.) and records the published URL when supplied.

nodes.name: logBriefPerformance
nodes.summary: Persists raw post-publish view and engagement metrics to brief_performance for downstream prediction labeling.

nodes.name: dismissAlert
nodes.summary: Dismisses a proactive alert by recording the action type and emitting an audit event.

nodes.name: ok
nodes.summary: Helper that wraps a successful action result into the ClayActionResult envelope with title and subtitle for the UI confirmation card.

nodes.name: approveContentBrief
nodes.summary: Updates a content brief to approved state and emits the corresponding agent event.

nodes.name: sendInvite
nodes.summary: Sends a creator invite email and inserts an invite row, gated by agency_id and HMAC-signed token.

nodes.name: nudgeCreator
nodes.summary: Sends a nudge to a creator about a brief, integrated with the auto-nudge subsystem and emitting an audit event.

nodes.name: createAgencyEvent
nodes.summary: Creates a calendar event for an agency on behalf of a user, scoped by agency_id.

nodes.name: matchCreatorsToEvent
nodes.summary: Matches eligible creators in an agency to a calendar event and persists the matched set.

nodes.name: pushBriefToCreators
nodes.summary: Pushes a brief to a set of creators via email and the brief delivery queue, recording push status per recipient.

nodes.name: checkPushStatus
nodes.summary: Reports current delivery and acknowledgment status of a brief pushed to creators.

nodes.name: generateBatchBriefs
nodes.summary: Generates briefs for a batch of creators in one agency action, emitting batch metadata for audit.

nodes.name: schedulePost
nodes.summary: Schedules a brief for publication at a given time, updating the scheduled_post row.

nodes.name: generateReport
nodes.summary: Generates an agency performance report from the brief and metrics tables, returning a downloadable artifact reference.

nodes.name: reschedulePost
nodes.summary: Reschedules an already-scheduled post to a new time, validating the new slot against agency timezone.

nodes.name: component-data-fetcher.ts
nodes.summary: Server-side data loaders for every Clay UI card (morning brief, creator profile, KPIs, trends, performance timeline, momentum decay, trainer results, etc.) fetched from Supabase.

nodes.name: fetchComponentData
nodes.summary: Dispatches a component type to its specific fetcher, returning typed card data for the Clay renderer.

nodes.name: fetchMorningBrief
nodes.summary: Fetches the morning briefing payload: pending briefs, top trends, alerts, and key KPIs from Supabase.

nodes.name: fetchContentBrief
nodes.summary: Fetches a single content brief by id including creator metadata and predicted performance score.

nodes.name: fetchCreatorProfile
nodes.summary: Fetches a creator profile with channel stats, recent posts, and current prediction trajectory.

nodes.name: fetchKPISummary
nodes.summary: Computes agency-wide KPI summary (active briefs, published posts, average views, top creators) from Supabase aggregates.

nodes.name: fetchTrendCard
nodes.summary: Fetches detected trend event data plus associated creators and recent brief generations from the trend.

nodes.name: fetchPerformanceTimeline
nodes.summary: Fetches a time-series of brief publish/performance points for a creator or agency over a window.

nodes.name: fetchMomentumDecay
nodes.summary: Computes momentum decay signals for a creator (drop in views, engagement, posting cadence) and returns a decay score with reasons.

nodes.name: fetchTrainerResult
nodes.summary: Fetches the latest trainer experiment result for an agency or creator including outcome metrics.

nodes.name: fetchProactiveAlert
nodes.summary: Fetches a proactive alert row by id plus its supporting evidence (linked brief, trend, or creator).

nodes.name: fetchNetworkInsight
nodes.summary: Fetches cross-creator network insights such as shared trend exposure and collaboration opportunities within the agency.

nodes.name: fetchMemoryFact
nodes.summary: Retrieves a memory fact row from the agent memory store including its embedding source and timestamp.

nodes.name: fetchCalendarSnippet
nodes.summary: Fetches upcoming scheduled posts and agency events for a calendar snippet card, ordered by start time.

nodes.name: fetchAgencyScorecard
nodes.summary: Builds an agency-wide scorecard across creators with composite engagement, posting cadence, and prediction accuracy metrics.

nodes.name: fetchVariantComparison
nodes.summary: Fetches multiple AI-generated variants for a brief with their predicted scores for side-by-side comparison.

nodes.name: component-registry.ts
nodes.summary: Static catalog of Clay components mapping component types to specs (title, description, supported intents) plus a getter to retrieve components matching an intent.

nodes.name: component-renderer.tsx
nodes.summary: React renderer that maps a Clay component type and data payload to the appropriate card component, with skeleton fallbacks and unified action dispatch.

nodes.name: ClayComponentRenderer
nodes.summary: React component that switches on Clay component type and renders the matching card with its data props and onAction callback.

nodes.name: renderComponents
nodes.summary: Helper that maps a list of Clay component types and data payloads to ClayComponentRenderer instances for batch rendering.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the Clay subsystem: component registry, renderer, action handler, intent classifier, and action/triage types.
